description: This file is a Node.js script for analyzing source code boundaries within a plugin SDK, particularly for extension boundary validation. It reads source files, classifies module specifiers, and produces inventories and diffs for boundary violations, intended for use as a command-line utility.

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects source code files from the extension directory, excluding test-like sources and certain directories.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Reads and parses collected source files into TypeScript sourceFile ASTs.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Determines the extension root path segments based on a file path.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Generates a human-readable reason string for a module specifier classification based on the mode and resolved path.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting inventory entries.

methods.name: shouldReport
methods.description: Determines whether a given resolved import path should be included in the inventory based on mode.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Analyzes a source file for import/module specifiers, classifies them into modes, and returns entries.
